name: WorkID verified job board landing page by WorkID.ai
description: A centered, single-column landing page that alternates white sections with soft light-gray rounded panels to control pacing. Trust is the visual system: green 'Verified' chips, a 95-of-100 trust-score progress bar, and check-badged avatars, all demonstrated inside an annotated profile-card mockup rather than photography. Type is a single geometric sans with scale doing the work — a ~60px two-line hero, 36px section heads, 16px body — while a casual script face with hand-drawn arrows supplies the only decorative voice. Colour is disciplined: near-black text, one blue pill CTA repeated four times down the page, green reserved strictly for verification, black pills for secondary actions. Below the hero the rhythm tightens into utility — a search row with black button, three bordered job cards, a dotted Europe map scattered with avatar chips, a logo-pill grid ending in a skeleton 'your company could be here' chip — before a dense, functional footer with tagline, contact chip, three link columns and a small-print disclaimer.
